title: How Well Do Decision Models Transfer to Vietnamese? An Empirical Study of Text Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.31422v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent advances in specialized decision models have expanded the possibilities for zero-shot classification, yet their effectiveness on Vietnamese remains underexplored. This study evaluates four specialized decision models across 13 classification settings spanning six task groups, examining zero-shot performance, sensitivity to label-description language, and robustness to Vietnamese linguistic variations. The evaluation considers English, Vietnamese, and bilingual label descriptions, alongside common linguistic perturbations involving teencode, typographical errors, and diacritic removal. Under English label descriptions, JEV achieves the strongest overall performance, ranking first in 11 classification settings. The effects of label-description language vary across models and datasets, with bilingual descriptions providing no consistent improvement. translated_title: 决策模型对越南语的迁移效果如何？一项文本分类的实证研究
translated_abstract: 专用决策模型的最新进展为零样本分类拓展了新的可能性，但它们在越南语上的有效性仍未得到充分探索。本研究在涵盖六个任务组的13个分类设置中评估了四种专用决策模型，考察了它们的零样本性能、对标签描述语言的敏感性以及对越南语语言变化的鲁棒性。评估考虑了英语、越南语和双语标签描述，并涉及网络缩写语、拼写错误和声调符号去除等常见语言扰动。在英语标签描述下，JEV取得了最强的整体性能，在11个分类设置中排名第一。标签描述语言的影响因模型和数据集而异，双语描述并未带来一致的提升。鲁棒性实验表明，去除声调符号造成了最显著的性能下降。
tldr: 本文在13个越南语文本分类设置中评估了四种专用决策模型，发现JEV在英语标签描述下表现最佳，双语标签描述并无一致提升，而去除声调符号对模型性能的影响最为严重。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates four specialized decision models across 13 Vietnamese text classification settings, finding that JEV achieves the best overall performance with English label descriptions, bilingual descriptions offer no consistent improvement, and diacritic removal causes the most substantial performance degradation.
